About Brescia

A Catholic school community in Bryanston, shaped by learning, faith and service.

Our identity

An education
with purpose.

Brescia House School is an independent Catholic girls’ school offering Grades R–12. Its Ursuline identity places service alongside education and personal development.

The school celebrated its 60th birthday in January 2026.
